title: An all-powerful God needs your defense?

top_liked.author: @MrPeabodyTheSkeptic
top_liked.text: It's like broke people defending a billionaire (millionaire?) with a tangerine tan.

top_liked.author: @emenanjonwadiei
top_liked.text:
"Why does God need a starship?"
- Capt. James T. Kirk

top_liked.author: @kenbattor6350
top_liked.text: Why would an all powerful being care about what I was doing

top_liked.author: @Eyesopeningheartrealigning
top_liked.text:
Absolutely 😅
Wish I’d thought about this sooner 😢
It is what it is and now to live the rest without the ‘Christian cloud’ 🎉

top_liked.author: @CB66941
top_liked.text: Why do fallible men need to explain the infallible word of God to me instead of letting me read the infallible word of God itself?

top_liked.author: @redacted461
top_liked.text:
Check yourself. There's a difference between saying "anything that's all powerful will not need you to defend it" and saying "you feel the need to defend it". I van feel the need to defend something without that something needing my defense
Pseudo intellectual crap lol

top_liked.author: @jordanjtbraun
top_liked.text:
Indeed. You are not completely wrong. God does not need me to "defend" Him. That is 100% true. 

The way I see it, I am invited into the work. 

Here is an illustration. I do not need my kids to help me do some chores, like change the oil on the car. I can do it myself, I do it…

top_liked.author: @mathieu9789
top_liked.text: Mate, that was so meaningful, seriously. I struggle at times with the persistant antagonism thrown at me for my catholic faith, requesting proof and the what-nots. thank you for reminding me
